selectedContract: PAL C64 NMOS 6510, KERNAL 901227-03 CINV post-save hook, caller-owned two-byte page-safe predecessor, original A and P preserved by vector updates, IRQ handler enters with firmware-saved A/X/Y and D cleared before user code, previous handler sees its entry P before chain

chainEntry.measurement: Wrapper and one constant byte store, excluding predecessor execution and firmware-owned register saves

exclusiveEntry.measurement: Wrapper and one constant byte store, excluding firmware restore tail

install.measurement: One CINV save and update with P/A preservation and IRQ masking, excluding the caller's JSR and handler body

restore.measurement: One CINV restore with P/A preservation and IRQ masking, excluding the caller's JSR

winPath: At whole-program scale, prove and reuse a storage-free helper across mainline and IRQ instead of duplicating identical code; keep fixed private homes only where overlap requires them.
